longBusinessSummary: Energy Absolute Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and distribution of crude palm oil, biodiesel, and glycerol products in Thailand. It operates through five segments: Manufacturing and distributing crude palm oil, biodiesel products, and pure glycerin products; Manufacturing and distributing electricity from solar and wind power and biomass; Manufacturing and distributing electric vehicles; Manufacturing and distributing batteryl; and Others. The company provides phase change materials, as well as electric bus, car, and ferry. It also produces and distributes solar and wind electric power from renewable energy, as well as operates waste to energy and waste management projects; and service of property rental, sale and rent a bus service, supply assets service, and investing in other businesses. In addition, the company is involved in construction projects consulting; research and development of electricity equipment; hire purchase of electric vehicles; shore tank rental and crude palm oil pipeline transport services; research, development, manufacture, and distribution of lithium-ion batteries for applications, such as electric automobiles and energy storage systems; and operation of charging stations. The company was formerly known as Suntech Palm Oil Ltd. and changed its name to Energy Absolute Public Company Limited in 2008. Energy Absolute Public Company Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
